title: Introduction
description: Build a game people play together in one room, inside the app they already open.

title: The manifest
description: The one JSON document you publish that is the whole of what Gathering knows about your game.

title: Getting listed
description: From a published manifest to a tile in the store: registration by URL, the store copy, publishing, and what a new version means.

title: Authentication
description: The launch, the one-time code, the token your server trades it for, and the bridge that says who arrived.

title: The bridge
description: window.gathering: the room, the players, the friends and the app's chrome, from inside your page.

title: Rooms
description: Who may be in a room, the rounds it plays, the frames the relay carries, the ticket your server verifies and the results it posts.

title: Notifications
description: Tell a player something from your own server: the inbox and the push to their phone, the deep link that opens your game, the key that keeps one line per thing, and the limits.

title: Tournaments
description: Knockouts and leagues of your game: match rooms, why every round must be ranked, and the bridge's tournament calls.

title: The app
description: The API behind the app a player opens: what it is, how calls are made, and the one session.

title: Sign-in and sessions
description: A phone, a code, a session. Refreshing it, ending it, and who is signed in.
